scripts.name: what to bring to the lighthouse

when.user_text: I want to walk to the old lighthouse on Saturday. What should I bring?

blocks.text:
For a day walk to the old lighthouse, bring:

- Water, at least a litre for each person.
- A windproof jacket. The headland is exposed even on a warm day.
- Shoes with a good grip, because the last stretch is loose stone.
- Something to eat at the top. There is no shop past the harbour.
- A paper map of the headland, since the signal drops after the second gate.

scripts.name: how long the lighthouse walk is

when.user_text: How long is the walk there and back?

blocks.text: By the harbour road it is about nine kilometres there and back. Allow three hours, with a stop at the top.

scripts.name: how long the cliff path is

when.user_text: How long is the walk if I take the cliff path instead?

blocks.text: The cliff path is shorter and slower: about seven kilometres there and back, and closer to four hours, because of the two climbs. Leave it for a dry day.
